name: ottermind

plugins.name: sqlx
plugins.description: List saved OtterMind SQLX datasources, test connections, execute SQL against MySQL, MariaDB, TiDB, GreatSQL, OceanBase, PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, YugabyteDB, openGauss, Oracle, SQL Server, ClickHouse, Trino, StarRocks, Apache Doris and TDengine, and open local result pages. Credentials stay in the SQLX data directory.

description: OtterMind plugins for Claude Code. Currently ships SQLX for MySQL, MariaDB, TiDB, GreatSQL, OceanBase, PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, YugabyteDB, openGauss, Oracle, SQL Server, ClickHouse, Trino, StarRocks, Apache Doris and TDengine.
